description: This Java source file defines the PolicyId class, which represents a unique identifier for policies within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating, comparing, and managing policy IDs based on namespace and name, with support for randomly generated IDs and a dummy placeholder.

classes.name: PolicyId
classes.description: Immutable class representing a unique policy identifier in the Eclipse Ditto framework, with static factory methods and equality/hashCode implementations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a PolicyId from a CharSequence, bypassing validation if input is already a PolicyId.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a PolicyId with specified namespace and policy name.

methods.name: inNamespaceWithRandomName
methods.description: Generates a PolicyId with a specified namespace and a random UUID name.

methods.name: dummy
methods.description: Returns a dummy PolicyId instance, used as a placeholder.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the policy name part of the ID.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace part of the ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the underlying NamespacedEntityId.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the underlying NamespacedEntityId.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the underlying entity ID.

methods.name: isDummy
methods.description: Indicates if this PolicyId is a dummy (placeholder) ID.
